{"CommandLine":"& "D:\CareBridge AI\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -c "
import os, sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from app import create_app
from app.core.database import get_database
from app.utils.security import create_access_token
from bson import ObjectId

app = create_app()
client = app.test_client()
with app.app_context():
    db = get_database()
    staff = db.users.find_one({'email': 'staff@carebridge.ai'})
    token = create_access_token({'sub': str(staff['_id']), 'email': staff['email'], 'role': staff['role']})
    headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}

    # 1. Test GET /api/patients
    r1 = client.get('/api/patients?page=1&limit=5&sort=newest', headers=headers)
    print('GET Status:', r1.status_code)
    d1 = r1.get_json()
    print('GET Total:', d1.get('total'), 'Stats:', d1.get('stats'))
    print('First patient:', d1['patients'][0]['name'], d1['patients'][0]['patientId'], d1['patients'][0]['phone'])

    # 2. Test Validation rejection
    r_val = client.post('/api/patients', headers=headers, data=json.dumps({
        'name': 'string',
        'phone': '123'
    }))
    print('Validation Rejection Status:', r_val.status_code, r_val.get_json())

    # 3. Test Create Patient with account
    test_phone = '+91 9999112233'
    test_email = 'new.patient.test@carebridge.org'
    # cleanup first if exists
    db.patients.delete_one({'phone': test_phone})
    db.users.delete_one({'email': test_email})

    r_create = client.post('/api/patients', headers=headers, data=json.dumps({
        'name': 'Drishya Reddy',
        'phone': '9999112233',
        'email': test_email,
        'age': 27,
        'gender': 'Female',
        'blood_group': 'B+',
        'allergies': 'Aspirin, Shellfish',
        'medical_history': 'Migraines',
        'create_account': True
    }))
    print('Create Status:', r_create.status_code)
    d_create = r_create.get_json()
    print('Created Patient ID:', d_create.get('patientId'), 'Temp Password:', d_create.get('temp_password'), 'Account Created:', d_create.get('account_created'))

    # 4. Test Duplicate Protection
    r_dup = client.post('/api/patients', headers=headers, data=json.dumps({
        'name': 'Duplicate User',
        'phone': '9999112233'
    }))
    print('Duplicate Protection Status:', r_dup.status_code, r_dup.get_json().get('detail'))
